scope: Read-only geometry and recorded planner review. Native Track/racing line constructed; no simulation step or race rerun.
conclusions: The old profile threshold can report Infinity even when planNext is already below planLimit; the prior descending-profile helper fixes that contract.
PASS / COMMITTED is also emitted by generic trackPass bookkeeping. An attempt acquired while blocker is -1 has passPaced=false and does not consult the runway for commitment/abort.
The consumer receives min(geometric straight runway, profile runway), not the profile runway alone. Check the reconstructed geometric cap before attributing a commitment to Infinity.
The planner consumes the preceding approach plan at its tactical update; the recording body contains the subsequent latest plan. Geometry is independent of this one-update profile phase.
This four-second capture cannot rule out different effects of the runway contract earlier in the lap.
